product_overview: Wildlife Wonder Jewellery is an online storefront for browsing and purchasing jewelry products. Customers can explore the catalog, inspect product details, manage a shopping cart, and complete checkout after signing in; admins can review dashboard data and orders.
core_goals: Browse the jewelry catalog and find products of interest
View detailed product information before purchasing
Add items to a shopping cart and adjust quantities
Complete checkout with delivery details and payment
Access administrative sales and order information

features.name: Browse Jewelry Products
features.description: Customers can explore the jewelry shop catalog and open individual product pages to review item details.
user_flows: Navigate to /shop -> View the product catalog -> Open a product listing -> Review product images and option selectors
Navigate to /shop -> Browse the catalog -> Open a product listing -> Change the quantity selection -> Review the updated selection

features.name: Manage Shopping Cart
features.description: Customers can add products to the cart, review cart contents, update quantities, and remove items before purchasing.
user_flows: Navigate to /products/[id] -> Add the product to the cart -> Open /cart -> Review the item list and total price
Navigate to /cart -> Review cart contents -> Change an item quantity -> See the cart total update
Navigate to /cart -> Review cart contents -> Remove an item -> See the cart update with the item removed

features.name: User Login & Profile
features.description: Customers can sign in using Clerk credentials to access authenticated parts of the storefront such as checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Start sign in -> Complete login with Clerk credentials -> See the authenticated state
Navigate to /checkout -> Begin sign in when prompted -> Complete login with Clerk credentials -> Continue to checkout

features.name: Checkout
features.description: Signed-in customers can enter delivery details and complete payment during checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Enter delivery details -> Review payment information -> Submit checkout -> See order completion confirmation
Navigate to /checkout -> Enter incomplete delivery details -> Attempt to continue -> See validation feedback

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Authorized admins can review sales data and access order information from the admin area.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> View total sales and order charts -> Open the orders list tab -> Review order records
